content.text:
The task is complete. `/app/answers.json` is written with all 34 items.

**Mechanism found.** RSN-04 is the value screen. Every RSN-04 row was dropped at the exact instant its run finished, and every recovered RSN-04 value sits below the retention-policy floor in force at that time. RSN-11 is unrelated to values. All 17 rows are worker w01 on 2026-07-04, dropped together two days later, which matches one lost per-worker-per-day file. A third gap has no log at all. Workers w03 and w07 wrote nothing to the archive from mid 06-27 to mid 07-03, and recovered values from that window fall below the floor, so those rows were never screened. The grid is 0.0001, the gcd of every recorded and recovered value.

**Constraints applied to each missing value.**
- Suite range: at least 0.25 for arc_lite, at least 0 otherwise, at most 1.
- RSN-04 runs: at most floor minus 0.0001 for their policy version.
- RSN-11 runs: at least the floor, since they passed the screen before the file was lost.
- Never-recorded runs: suite range only.
- Daily digest: the unknown values on each UTC day must sum exactly to the digest total minus the known values.

Intervals came from an exact-fraction linear program solved day by day, which is tight because every bound and digest total lies on the grid. Two items are pinned exactly: cell b08 has no missing runs, and contrast k08 resolves because its unknowns cancel through the digest. Decisions came out as one yes, two no, and five cannot_tell.
